title: Private New Orleans Historic Neighborhood Food Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: The Sample menu is just an example and expected to change
Please let us know if you have any food allergies ahead of time
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Because of the amazing diversity of our local population, New Orleans has always been a city of neighborhoods. It is no secret that the city has always been a food town, and nowhere is that on greater display than in the many neighborhoods that have perfected their own addition to our great creole and Cajun food culture. We will see New Orleans through its many different neighborhoods and outside the French Quarter. Exploring New Orleans through its restaurants, neighborhood bars, and unexpected delights will allow you•to both see, eat and understand our unique culinary culture.
